subject.title: fix(ai): provider-billed totals desync the cost breakdown and drop cache writes

question: Should OpenClaw publish and support `Usage.cost.estimatedTotal` as the durable public companion to authoritative provider-billed `cost.total`?
rationale: The field is additive but exported through the plugin SDK and persisted across the worker protocol, so its meaning cannot be safely chosen by a mechanical repair loop.

options.title: Approve the two-total contract
options.body: Accept `total` as authoritative billed cost and `estimatedTotal` as the retained catalog breakdown, then add concise public contract documentation before merge.

options.title: Split the public surface
options.body: Land only the bounded cache-write and overflow fixes now, and move the new cost field plus protocol propagation into an owner-sponsored API proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve the two-total contract
recommendation.body: Accept `total` as authoritative billed cost and `estimatedTotal` as the retained catalog breakdown, then add concise public contract documentation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the public LLM usage type, agent transport behavior, and gateway transcript protocol.
